name: compact-tool
description: Gives Claude a compact tool for interactive sessions, so an automated workflow can compact the conversation at a natural boundary (optionally only past a context threshold) and carry on, up to a set number of times per session

maxCompactions.title: Max compactions per session
maxCompactions.description: How many times the tool may compact one session (a whole number, at least 1); past it the tool refuses. /clear starts the count again.
